claims.statement: C. W. Price was barkeeper at the Washington Avenue Free and Easy that Allen kept in his prime.
claims.excerpt: Price was tae barkeeper in the old Washington avenue Free and Easy which Tom Allen kept in his prime

claims.statement: C. W. Price, an Englishman, came to America with Tom Allen.
claims.excerpt: came to America with Tom Allen, the well-known pugilist

claims.statement: For some time after arriving in St. Louis, C. W. Price was Allen's protégé.
claims.excerpt: for some time after his arrival in St. Louis, Allen's protegee

notes: Article is mainly about Policeman C. W. Price; only the Allen links are kept.
